title: Add phase-coded callers, growing frames, and scoped closure limits
body:
This PR preserves reviewed constructions for phase-coded D25 and D73 callers, exact translation sections and services, and scoped closure theorems for current scalar codes. It makes the existing proofs and decisive checks portable. The direct paid caller profiles have native masses **5,600 = 224*25** and **16,352 = 224*73**, so they do not give a strict moment gain. **There is no improvement to the complete kappa calculation.**

The [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3c6a768e5391e6bc8355fe2bc849d2978afef8f6/research/phase-coded-callers/PROOF.md), [fresh replay receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3c6a768e5391e6bc8355fe2bc849d2978afef8f6/research/phase-coded-callers/REPLAY.json), [independent publication review](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3c6a768e5391e6bc8355fe2bc849d2978afef8f6/research/publication-reviews/phase-coded-callers/REVIEW.md), and [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3c6a768e5391e6bc8355fe2bc849d2978afef8f6/research/phase-coded-callers/SOURCES.json) define the claim. This is publication of existing campaign results, with no new source novelty claim.

The phase-coded local word has a 16/96 split, `D=-H*`, and a cost of 4,632 real scalar primitives. It preserves all 416 arbitrary helpers. Three legal FULL shears give `(-F25 q Y0,F25 q X0)` for arbitrary physical inputs. The Q-entry terminal adds 224 rank-one lines; the initial I-entry alternative adds 208. Each complete construction has mass 5,600. These are costs of two specified terminals, not a universal decoder lower bound. The actual nine-call chain carries one common q through D73 and gives `(F73 q Y0,-F73 q X0)`. Its direct terminal adds 224 lines. Scalar subtotals are 20,040 and 60,120 before terminal wrappers and map costs. No prospective cheaper local word is consumed.

The section and translation results have a separate 8/104 split with `D=B*`. Their all-width spectrum is `±{1,3,5,11,13}`. The positive-line right section has norm `sqrt(13)` and condition number 13; its oblique projector has norm 13. Its image complements the query kernel. The positive and inverse line images intersect. The odd-power obstruction holds at width at least five, with no minimum-width claim.

The exact T/T inverse shears, coded exchange, and one-bank inverse have zero native children under their stated existing-bank and owned-C0 contracts. Their scalar, odd-grid, and map costs stay separate. The [map-cost correction](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3c6a768e5391e6bc8355fe2bc849d2978afef8f6/research/phase-coded-callers/frozen/work/centre-encoding-campaign-20261014/lanes/native-escape-20261017/inplace-service-review/MAP-COST-CORRECTION.md) withdraws the general O(V) shortcut: all 144 simultaneous translations retain the applicable packed-map cost, plus sixteen outer views. The wrapper also corrects the historical odd-scan sentence to `64*n*(w_g+1)` arithmetic-head steps, plus stream control, for n complex records per field. Frozen source reviews remain unchanged.

For invertible scalar codes in current fresh charts, D25 logical monomial closure requires monomial stage codes at width at least two; physical monomial closure uses width at least three. Q commutation requires diagonal codes at width at least three. The general-stage proof gives sufficient widths T and T+1. The claim excludes old-chart controls, operator-valued codes, changed gathered interfaces, and paid joint decoders. It binds the final corrected `bound-normal` receipt. Route counts are not native child counts.

The [fixed-code appendix](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3c6a768e5391e6bc8355fe2bc849d2978afef8f6/research/phase-coded-callers/annexes/fixed-code-interface/PROOF.md) gives an independently reviewed criterion for one fixed scalar code to survive independent native port operators. The operators must agree on each component of the code projector's support graph. The pinned `ker R` graph is connected on all 112 ports, so all completed port operators must agree for that fixed-code contract; equal ranks are insufficient. Changing codes and joint array operators remain outside the result. The exact source graph check passes in normal Python and with `-O`.

```sh
python3 -I -B research/phase-coded-callers/annexes/fixed-code-interface/replay.py --out /tmp/fixed-code-interface-replay
```

Expected final output:

```text
PASS_SCOPED_SUPPORT_PROOF_REPLAY
```

Run from the repository root with Python 3.11 or later, its standard library, at least 3 GiB free disk, and a new output directory:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/phase-coded-callers/replay.py --out /tmp/phase-coded-callers-check
```

Expected final output:

```text
PASS_PHASE_CODED_CALLERS
```

All seven checks passed normally and with optimized Python. They freshly regenerate the local transcript for both providers, check all 640 inputs and helper returns, repeat the independent D25 phase proof, verify the actual D73 routes, check the section spectrum and literal service programs, and bind all 12,544 affine closure paths and 1,792 witnesses. The D25 negative controls reject omitted entry translations and false ordinary-FULL types. The D73 controls reject both entry-translation and exit-translation omission. The [validation contract](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3c6a768e5391e6bc8355fe2bc849d2978afef8f6/research/phase-coded-callers/VALIDATION.md) states exact comparison rules. A single [path-only adaptation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3c6a768e5391e6bc8355fe2bc849d2978afef8f6/research/phase-coded-callers/PORTABLE-ADAPTATION.json) resolves five unchanged source pins inside the copied repository. No imported module or mathematical check is changed.

The all-width results still require the retained proofs. Dense native kernel compilation, the recursive common-q consumer, a complete host and owner schedule, full map and stream pricing, and a complete numerical-grid proof were not supplied. The one-bank section service does not decode the 16/96 caller endpoint.

The packaging base is [b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51), which selects [PR #4470](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4470). No applicability to that selected construction is claimed; all historical source pins remain unchanged.

The provider comes from [PR #3133](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3133) at [51eb9c4ee9e4722010d308aa3309e039d3940cc2](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/51eb9c4ee9e4722010d308aa3309e039d3940cc2/research/rank7-coupled-586-588-carrier-fold/README.md), whose source credits @dcharb78. Jeremy Diviney (@jeremydiviney) supplied the byte-equal copies in [PR #3148](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3148) at [f2927a4b8afcf0701a6b945e14f30de1d94f5176](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f2927a4b8afcf0701a6b945e14f30de1d94f5176/research/coupled-carrier-cap740/README.md). The exact Clifford source comes from [PR #2588](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2588) at [8cd9dc88e24f062e2ca2fa7f4844a3d3319381fb](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8cd9dc88e24f062e2ca2fa7f4844a3d3319381fb/research/gmx-t74-borrow43-handoff/new/code/borrow/vendor/clifford/clifford_exact.py). The [notice](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3c6a768e5391e6bc8355fe2bc849d2978afef8f6/research/phase-coded-callers/NOTICE.md) preserves the full source credit and licenses. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance was used; the independent reviews are separate agent checks.

The append-only [phase-access proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3c6a768e5391e6bc8355fe2bc849d2978afef8f6/research/phase-coded-callers/annexes/phase-access/PROOF.md) preserves two distinct enabling mechanisms and the separate rational and dyadic capture reviews. Its [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3c6a768e5391e6bc8355fe2bc849d2978afef8f6/research/phase-coded-callers/annexes/phase-access/SOURCES.json), [replay receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3c6a768e5391e6bc8355fe2bc849d2978afef8f6/research/phase-coded-callers/annexes/phase-access/REPLAY.json), and [independent review](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3c6a768e5391e6bc8355fe2bc849d2978afef8f6/research/publication-reviews/phase-coded-callers/phase-access-review/REVIEW.md) are separate from the unchanged 298-file core. The growing Walsh theorem gives exact common-line phases, rank-eight/rank-nine children, and diagonal F73 adapters at every positive tensor width. Its typed rank is `8+((a+j-b) mod 2)`: alternating types give rank nine for frame transport `j=0`, but rank eight when an odd source phase `j=1` is inserted. The frame-only rank-81 schedule is not a source-phase caller invoice. This 9-to-73 construction differs from the doubled dimension-146 global lift in [PR #1719](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1719), pinned at [its retained global proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3ae9a6f3ac74ded022ab3b4872a7357a621af6fb/research/involutive-walsh-lift/GLOBAL-WALSH.md). It does not restore changed contents or admit new ambient routes.

The ordered phase-class identity reduces the actual capture to 56 active fields. The rational word costs 4,204 old real scalar units per direction, plus sixteen division-by-three scans forward or sixteen multiplication-by-three scans inverse. The separately reviewed dyadic rank-16 involution costs 4,044 scalar units and no odd scans; its coded additive words cost 1,544 units and use K forward and -K backward, not its transpose. The conditional 112-H1 factorization requires carried rank-four W_R, paid alignment and native side maps, and separate entry/exit costs. **Actual W45 fails all 56 pair ratios, each of rank two.** The rank-four lower bound covers one common Clifford, not arbitrary joint decoders. Boundary norm ten requires the literal class/active prefix conditions; scalar height three is not a physical-grid bound. Source access, contents, native phase wrappers, owner schedules, map costs, and the recursive invoice remain open. There is no complete kappa improvement or automatic applicability to the selected construction at base `b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51`.

The six fresh normal/optimized runs reproduce the complete frozen receipts byte for byte. They check exact Walsh kernels and route ranks, all 640 scalar inputs, both inverse orders, prefix bounds, and the actual frame ranks. Meaningful controls reject the omitted negative-difference update, distinguish K from its transpose, and show every W45 pair failure; the proof also retains the noncommuting inverse-alignment counterexample. The full native capture and global supplier were not rerun. Use Python 3.11 or later on a Unix-like system, its standard library, one worker, at least 3 GiB free disk, and a new output directory:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/phase-coded-callers/annexes/phase-access/replay.py --out /tmp/phase-access-check
```

Expected final output:

```text
PASS_PHASE_ACCESS_ANNEX
```

The [annex notice](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3c6a768e5391e6bc8355fe2bc849d2978afef8f6/research/phase-coded-callers/annexes/phase-access/NOTICE.md) records the distinct construction and review roles and preserved licenses. These are existing AI-assisted campaign results. No independent human review is claimed.
